metadata.technology: Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensor Probe (with MCU + radio)
metadata.technology_specification: Capacitive soil moisture sensor probe with integrated microcontroller unit (MCU) and wireless radio module
metadata.technology_reasoning: Capacitive soil moisture sensors are the industry-standard for soil moisture measurement due to their reliability and low power consumption. The integration with an MCU and radio module is typical in IoT agricultural applications for real-time, wireless soil monitoring, representing the dominant market variant in smart farming as of 2024.

components.reasoning: This is the core sensing element that measures soil moisture through capacitance changes; universally present and a distinct module.
The MCU processes sensor signals and controls data transmission; typically a separate electronic component with its own supply chain.
Provides wireless data communication (e.g., LoRa, Zigbee, or BLE), usually a discrete module integrated or attached on the PCBA.
The electronic board hosting the MCU, radio module, and other supporting circuitry, typically procured or manufactured as a unit.
Protects the sensor and electronics from environmental degradation; often a separately manufactured plastic or composite part.

components.component: Power Supply Module (Battery or Energy Harvesting Unit)
components.reasoning: Supplies power to the sensor system; in portable probes, batteries are standard and procured separately.
Enables wireless signal transmission; sometimes integrated on the radio module but often a separate component.

Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensing Probe.name: Ceramic
Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensing Probe.reasoning: Ceramic materials are commonly used in capacitive sensing probes for their dielectric properties and stability in soil environments, standard choice with few substitutes for consistent performance.

Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensing Probe.name: Copper
Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensing Probe.reasoning: Copper is essential for the conductive electrodes in the probe to sense capacitance changes related to soil moisture, universally used for conductivity.

Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensing Probe.name: Polyethylene
Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensing Probe.reasoning: Used for insulating layers and protective coatings in the probe, common polymer though alternatives like PTFE exist but less common due to cost.

Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensing Probe.name: Silicon dioxide
Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensing Probe.reasoning: Often used as an insulating or passivation layer in sensor electrodes, common in sensor fabrication with some alternatives possible.

Microcontroller Unit (MCU).name: Silicon
Microcontroller Unit (MCU).reasoning: Silicon is the foundational semiconductor material for integrated circuits in the MCU, absolutely essential with no viable substitutes in commercial MCU manufacturing.

Microcontroller Unit (MCU).name: Copper
Microcontroller Unit (MCU).reasoning: Copper is used extensively for interconnects inside the MCU silicon chip and package leads, industry standard conductor though alternatives like aluminum exist but less common in modern MCUs.

Microcontroller Unit (MCU).name: Aluminum
Microcontroller Unit (MCU).reasoning: Aluminum is used for some interconnect layers and packaging, commonly used though copper has largely replaced it in interconnects, still present in packaging and wires.

Microcontroller Unit (MCU).name: Silicon dioxide
Microcontroller Unit (MCU).reasoning: Used as an insulating layer and gate oxide in silicon semiconductor devices, essential for transistor function in MCUs.

Wireless Radio Module.name: Silicon
Wireless Radio Module.reasoning: Silicon is the primary semiconductor material in RF integrated circuits for wireless communication, essential and industry standard.

Wireless Radio Module.name: Copper
Wireless Radio Module.reasoning: Copper is used for internal wiring and antenna feeding circuits within the module, standard choice for conductivity.

Wireless Radio Module.name: Aluminum
Wireless Radio Module.reasoning: Aluminum can be used in the shielding and packaging parts of the radio module, common but sometimes replaced by other metals.

Wireless Radio Module.name: Silicon dioxide
Wireless Radio Module.reasoning: Used as an insulating layer within semiconductor devices and packaging in radio modules, widely used for electrical isolation.

Printed Circuit Board Assembly (PCBA).name: Copper
Printed Circuit Board Assembly (PCBA).reasoning: Copper is essential for PCB traces and internal wiring, universally used in PCBs for electrical connectivity.

Printed Circuit Board Assembly (PCBA).name: Fiberglass
Printed Circuit Board Assembly (PCBA).reasoning: Fiberglass is the primary reinforcing material in PCB substrates (FR4), standard in industry for mechanical strength and electrical insulation.

Printed Circuit Board Assembly (PCBA).name: Epoxy resins
Printed Circuit Board Assembly (PCBA).reasoning: Epoxy resins bind fiberglass layers providing mechanical support and insulation, common and standard in PCB fabrication.

Printed Circuit Board Assembly (PCBA).name: Tin
Printed Circuit Board Assembly (PCBA).reasoning: Tin is used in soldering for component attachment on PCBs, commonly used though lead-free solder alloys include tin as main component.

Protective Probe Housing / Enclosure.name: Acrylonitrile butadiene styrene
Protective Probe Housing / Enclosure.reasoning: ABS plastic is widely used for protective housings due to strength, durability, and ease of molding, very common choice though other plastics exist.

Protective Probe Housing / Enclosure.name: Polycarbonate
Protective Probe Housing / Enclosure.reasoning: Polycarbonate is also used in housing for impact resistance and clarity, an alternative to ABS in some designs.

Protective Probe Housing / Enclosure.name: Silicon dioxide
Protective Probe Housing / Enclosure.reasoning: Silicon dioxide may be present in coatings or glasses used in the enclosure, uncertain but possible for protective or optical layers.

Power Supply Module (Battery or Energy H.name: Lithium
Power Supply Module (Battery or Energy H.reasoning: Lithium is a critical element in rechargeable batteries commonly used in power supply modules, standard with no commercial alternatives equivalently practical.

Power Supply Module (Battery or Energy H.name: Copper
Power Supply Module (Battery or Energy H.reasoning: Copper is used in battery current collectors and internal wiring, essential for electrical conduction.

Power Supply Module (Battery or Energy H.name: Aluminum
Power Supply Module (Battery or Energy H.reasoning: Aluminum is often used as cathode current collector and casing material in batteries, standard industry material.

Antenna.name: Copper
Antenna.reasoning: Copper is the dominant conductor in antenna elements for wireless communication due to high conductivity and ease of fabrication.

Antenna.name: Aluminum
Antenna.reasoning: Aluminum can be used as an antenna conductor material in some designs, less common but viable alternative to copper.

Antenna.name: Polyethylene
Antenna.reasoning: Used as insulating and protective coating material around antenna elements, commonly used polymer though alternatives exist.
